items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 27 August 2026 9:13am
items.description:
##Yesterday##

Dry and bright morning but soon turning wet this afternoon, the rain becoming heavy at times.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 15°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

7-15, risk of local 20-25


##Wind Speed##

15


##Wind Direction##

E


##Wind##

E or NE 10-15, locally 15-20 this morning, backing N overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in the rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Heavy rain at times this afternoon & evening, small chance of thunder.


##Today##

Outbreaks of rain at first, becoming mostly dry with sunny intervals.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 14°C and max. air temperature 20°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4 at first


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

W


##Wind##

N or NW 10-15, backing W or NW 15-20, but locally 20-25 in north for a while, decreasing 10-15 overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate at first. Occasional hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain soon arriving, becoming dry at night.


##Temperature##

##Rainfall (mm):##

2-6


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW

W or SW 10, soon S or SE 10-15, then VRB 5-10, becoming W or SW 10-15 overnight.

Good, falling moderate in rain. Hill fog.


##Comments##

Nil.


##Sunday, 30 August 2026##

Bright with sunny intervals, then showers later.

1-3 later

15

SW
